subject: Control Plane connector sync: IdP / SCIM deployment & parity questions
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@galeon.com>, ops@redwood.ai
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Jun 2025 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Control Plane connector sync: IdP / SCIM deployment & parity questions

Hi Alex / Galeon team —

Thanks again for the call this morning. As discussed, we're preparing the private control plane connector package for your VPC deployment. Attached are: (1) proposed SCIM attribute mapping (scim-attribute-mapping.xlsx), (2) our recommended service account role bindings, and (3) a rough network topology for the connector (privcp-network-topology.drawio).

High-level asks for Galeon so we can finalize the runbook: 
- Can you confirm which SAML NameID format your IdP will assert (email vs transient vs persistent)?
- Do you have a SP-initiated or IdP-initiated preference for SSO during cutover?
- Any SCIM rate-limiting constraints / attribute transforms we should be aware of?

Operational notes: the connector will run in your VPC (air-gapped option available), require these outbound egress rules for control-plane telemetry to our private control plane endpoints (listed in the drawio), and will use a short-lived cert we rotate via your KMS integration. If possible please attach your IdP metadata (SAML) so we can pre-provision the Service Provider side.

Proposed next steps: 
1) You share SAML metadata + any cert rotation windows
2) We validate attribute mapping and update SCIM schema to match your user directory
3) Schedule a dry-run for account sync outside business hours (2-hour window)

Attaching scim-attribute-mapping.xlsx and privcp-network-topology.drawio.

Thanks —
Jasmine Liu
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.ai
(attachment: scim-attribute-mapping.xlsx / application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)
(attachment: privcp-network-topology.drawio / application/xml)

From: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@galeon.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Jun 2025 11:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Control Plane connector sync: IdP / SCIM deployment & parity questions

Hi Jasmine —

Thanks for the clear list. Quick answers inline: 
- NameID: we will assert email (urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:emailAddress).
- Initiation: preference is SP-initiated for the first cutover, then IdP-initiated for user convenience.
- SCIM: our directory team enforces a 10 requests/sec per client throttle; transformations are handled upstream but we will supply custom attributes in the metadata.

I attached our SAML metadata (galeon-saml-metadata.xml) and a signing cert (expires 2026-01-14). There is a planned certificate rotation in November—we can provide an overlap period.

Two questions for Redwood ops: 
1) Can your SCIM connector honor incremental delta syncs (we prefer incremental over full for ~45k users)?
2) Does your role mapping support multiple role sources (LDAP groups + SCIM externalGroup)?

Alex
Identity & Access Lead, Galeon Systems
alex.morgan@galeon.com
(attachment: galeon-saml-metadata.xml / application/samlmetadata+xml)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>, Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@galeon.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 13 Jun 2025 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Control Plane connector sync: IdP / SCIM deployment & parity questions

Alex / team —

Short answers: yes on incremental/delta syncs (we use SCIM v2 with incremental change tokens) and yes on multi-source role resolution — we support an ordered mapping where LDAP group membership and SCIM externalGroup can be composed into a final role set. 

Operational checklist items I want to confirm before dry-run: 
- SCIM throttling: we'll implement exponential backoff and a client-side rate limiter to stay under 10 rps; we will also throttle by tenant during heavy operations.
- NameID mapping: we'll treat email NameID as the primary key but will accept a secondary persistent id if supplied.
- Cert rotation: we need a 48-hour overlap window where old and new certs are both valid for SAML assertions.
- Service account roles: see comments in scim-attribute-mapping.xlsx (sheet: roles) — need a final OK from your infra team.

I'll schedule a pre-cutover runbook review next week. Laura — can you draft the role mapping paragraph for the runbook?

Ben
Senior Engineering Manager, Inference Ops
ben.carter@redwood.ai

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@galeon.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Jun 2025 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Control Plane connector sync: IdP / SCIM deployment & parity questions

Ben / Jasmine / Alex —

Thanks — I drafted the role mapping we should include in the runbook. See excerpt below (copied into the thread for visibility):

--- quoted runbook fragment ---
Role resolution model for Galeon Systems private control plane connector:
1) Source precedence: SCIM externalGroup (highest) -> LDAP groups -> IdP assertions (roles claim).
2) Mapping rules: prefix mapping is used to separate Galeon groups (galeon:) from Redwood builtin roles (redwood:readonly, redwood:operator). Example: galeon:eng -> redwood:inference_engineer.
3) Entitlement sync window: incremental every 15 minutes; full sync weekly at 03:00 UTC (off-hours).
4) Fallback behavior: if SCIM delta fails, connector will attempt a full sync once and then pause with exponential backoff; operator alert to oncall via PagerDuty.
5) Auditing: all role changes logged to the control plane audit stream and exported to your SIEM via push-forward (s3 -> syslog) for 90 days retention by default; extension available on request.
--- end excerpt ---

Action items for Galeon: please confirm prefix mapping and the incremental window. Also confirm whether the team wants role reconciliation to be authoritative (i.e., Redwood overwrites local group membership) or advisory.

If agreed, I'll add this to the runbook and attach a short approval section for your identity team to sign off.

Laura Bennett
Principal Product Manager, Private Deployments
laura.bennett@redwood.ai

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@galeon.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 18 Jun 2025 16:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Control Plane connector sync: IdP / SCIM deployment & parity questions

Alex / team —

Appreciate the quick turn. Based on the thread we've: 
- Confirmed NameID=email and SP-initiated initial cutover.
- SCIM delta supported; we'll honor the 10rps throttle and implement client-side limiter.
- Role mapping model drafted and awaiting your confirmation on prefix mapping (suggest galeon:).
- Certificate rotation window requirement noted (48-hour overlap).

Next concrete items: 
1) Galeon to confirm prefix mapping and whether reconciliation is authoritative (please reply).
2) We'll run a dry incremental sync: proposed window Friday 2025-06-27 02:00-04:00 UTC (2 hours).
3) Pre-cutover runbook (draft) shared here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0Bxy-example-connector-plan — request review by 2025-06-20.

I'll set up a 30-minute cutover coordination call for Tuesday 2025-06-24 09:00 PT and include an ops playbook checklist.

Thanks everyone —
Jasmine Liu
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.ai
(attachment: scim-attribute-mapping.xlsx / application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)
